# `foxglove attachments download`

[Command reference](README.md) · [Parent command](attachments.md)

```text

Usage: foxglove attachments download [OPTIONS] <ATTACHMENT_ID>

Arguments:

Options:
      --client-id <CLIENT_ID>
          Foxglove client ID

      --config <CONFIG>

      --debug[=<DEBUG>]
```
